verdict.rationale: WorkOS's own docs say directory updates can be delivered via webhooks or pulled through an Events API, and the Rust SDK lists webhook helpers, so first-party outbound webhooks exist. The evidence only shows webhooks for Directory Sync, though, and gives no detail on registering endpoints or which events are available. Missing for 10: documented endpoint registration and subscription management, event-type catalog beyond Directory Sync, signature verification and retry details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Directory updates can be delivered to you via webhooks or retrieved using the Events API.
Directory Sync sends automatic updates to your app for changes to directories, groups, users, or access rules.
